nodes.rationale: Spec approval precedes planning, plan/task approval precedes implementation, and completed work is validated before closure.

nodes.label: Bilingual interface and English identifiers
nodes.rationale: Internal identifiers remain English while visible text follows the saved Spanish or English preference, with Spanish initially.

nodes.label: Design brief and verification alignment
nodes.rationale: Visible interface changes keep the design handoff synchronized and are checked with build and browser review.

nodes.label: Fixed React, TypeScript, and Vite stack
nodes.norm_label: fixed react, typescript, and vite stack
nodes.rationale: Keeping pinned dependencies and avoiding additions preserves the project's simple stack.

nodes.label: Local IndexedDB data preservation
nodes.rationale: Inventory remains local and migrations preserve existing records without sending data to external services.

nodes.label: Persistence and validation stay in the repository layer
nodes.norm_label: persistence and validation stay in the repository layer
nodes.rationale: Separating IndexedDB rules from interface components keeps domain logic centralized.

nodes.label: Accessible responsive interface
nodes.rationale: Keyboard access, visible focus, readable type, and narrow-screen behavior are repeated constraints across the documented screens.

nodes.label: Historical data is never inferred from current records
nodes.norm_label: historical data is never inferred from current records
nodes.rationale: Incomplete and orphaned events display only stored values so later edits or category renames cannot rewrite the past.

nodes.label: Atomic Lifecycle Update
nodes.rationale: Store the updated article and corresponding movement together in the existing IndexedDB transaction to avoid partial audit records.

nodes.label: Read-Time Legacy Status Resolution
nodes.rationale: Presentation-time fallback preserves legacy data until an explicit user save.

nodes.label: Legacy Status Read Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Resolve missing or blank legacy status as available only for presentation so reads do not rewrite stored inventory.

nodes.label: Terminal decommissioning with atomic save
nodes.rationale: A decommissioned item remains auditable, so the repository and interface block later edits and deletion while committing its transition and movement together.

nodes.label: Inventory and Audit Data Integrity
nodes.rationale: Language and display-format changes affect presentation only, preserving user-entered values and canonical stored costs and timestamps.

nodes.label: Browser-Local IndexedDB Persistence
nodes.rationale: The app runs without login or service configuration, and its browser-profile data does not synchronize across devices.

nodes.label: Prefer Statically Analyzable Paths
nodes.rationale: Explicit paths let build tools keep imports and file tracing narrow and predictable, reducing bundle size, build time, cold starts, and memory use.

nodes.label: Conditional Module Loading
nodes.rationale: Loading large modules only after a feature is activated reduces initial and server bundle work.

nodes.label: Defer Non-Critical Third-Party Libraries
nodes.rationale: Analytics and similar libraries do not block interaction, so they can load after hydration.

nodes.label: Dynamic Imports for Heavy Components
nodes.rationale: Lazy-loading large components keeps them out of the initial render bundle.

nodes.label: Preload Based on User Intent
nodes.rationale: Preloading on hover, focus, or an enabled feature flag reduces perceived latency before a module is needed.

nodes.label: React You Might Not Need an Effect

nodes.label: React guidance on moving logic to event handlers
nodes.norm_label: react guidance on moving logic to event handlers

nodes.label: Narrow Effect Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Primitive dependencies and derived booleans limit effect reruns to meaningful changes.

nodes.label: Calculate Derived State During Rendering
nodes.rationale: Compute values from current props or state during render instead of duplicating state and synchronizing it with an effect, preventing extra renders and drift.

nodes.label: Subscribe to Derived State
nodes.rationale: Subscribe to a derived boolean instead of a continuous value so updates happen only when the meaningful condition changes.

nodes.label: Use Functional setState Updates
nodes.rationale: Functional updates read the latest state, preventing stale closures and allowing callbacks to remain stable without state dependencies.

nodes.label: Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers
nodes.norm_label: put interaction logic in event handlers
nodes.rationale: Run side effects in the handler for the triggering user action instead of mirroring the action in state and an effect.

nodes.label: Split Combined Hook Computations
nodes.rationale: Separate independent calculations or effects by dependency set so unrelated work does not rerun.

nodes.label: Cache Repeated Function Calls
nodes.rationale: Cache repeated results for identical inputs to avoid redundant computations; a module-level Map works outside React hooks.

nodes.label: Cache Property Access in Loops
nodes.rationale: Store repeated object lookups and array length before hot loops to reduce lookups per iteration.

nodes.label: Cache Storage API Calls
nodes.rationale: Storage and cookie reads are synchronous and expensive, so cache them in memory and invalidate when external changes may occur.

nodes.label: Build Index Maps for Repeated Lookups
nodes.norm_label: build index maps for repeated lookups
nodes.rationale: Building a Map once changes repeated key lookup work from linear scans to constant-time access.

nodes.label: Use Set/Map for O(1) Lookups
nodes.rationale: Set and Map membership checks replace repeated linear array searches with constant-time lookups.

nodes.label: Prevent Hydration Mismatch Without Flickering
nodes.rationale: A synchronous pre-hydration script reads client storage and updates the DOM before React hydrates, avoiding server access errors and visible default-state flashes.

nodes.label: Suppress Expected Hydration Mismatches
nodes.rationale: Suppress warnings only for intentional server/client differences such as dates or locale formatting, and avoid hiding real bugs.

nodes.label: Use useTransition Over Manual Loading States
nodes.norm_label: use usetransition over manual loading states
nodes.rationale: The transition's pending state manages loading and keeps urgent UI updates responsive without manual loading toggles.

nodes.label: Defer State Reads to Usage Point
nodes.norm_label: defer state reads to usage point
nodes.rationale: Read dynamic values on demand inside callbacks when rendering does not need them, avoiding unnecessary subscriptions.

nodes.label: Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates
nodes.rationale: Mark frequent non-urgent updates as transitions so urgent interactions remain responsive.

nodes.label: Use useDeferredValue for Expensive Derived Renders
nodes.norm_label: use usedeferredvalue for expensive derived renders
nodes.rationale: Defer expensive renders driven by user input and memoize the derivation against the deferred value to keep input responsive.

nodes.label: Use useRef for Transient Values
nodes.rationale: Keep frequently changing temporary values in refs when they do not need rendering, avoiding a React render on every update.

nodes.label: Chrome DevTools Visual, Interaction, and Accessibility Validation
nodes.norm_label: chrome devtools visual, interaction, and accessibility validation

nodes.label: Combine Multiple Array Iterations
nodes.rationale: A single loop can produce multiple filtered results without repeatedly traversing the same array.

nodes.label: Early Return from Functions
nodes.rationale: Return when a result is determined to avoid processing remaining items.

nodes.label: Use flatMap to Map and Filter in One Pass
nodes.norm_label: use flatmap to map and filter in one pass
nodes.rationale: flatMap combines conditional transformation and filtering in one pass without an intermediate array.

nodes.label: Early Length Check for Array Comparisons
nodes.norm_label: early length check for array comparisons
nodes.rationale: Different lengths prove arrays unequal, so checking length first avoids needless sorting, joining, and memory use.

nodes.label: Use Loop for Min/Max Instead of Sort
nodes.norm_label: use loop for min/max instead of sort
nodes.rationale: A single pass finds extrema without sorting or copying the full array; loops also avoid spread limits on large arrays.

nodes.label: Use toSorted() Instead of sort() for Immutability
nodes.norm_label: use tosorted() instead of sort() for immutability
nodes.rationale: toSorted preserves the original array, avoiding mutation bugs with React props and state; spread plus sort is a fallback.

nodes.label: Authenticate Server Actions Like API Routes
nodes.norm_label: authenticate server actions like api routes
nodes.rationale: Authenticate and authorize inside each callable Server Action and validate input before mutation.

nodes.label: Cross-Request LRU Caching
nodes.rationale: Use an LRU for data shared across sequential requests; cache scope and sharing depend on the runtime.

nodes.label: Per-Request Deduplication with React.cache()
nodes.rationale: React.cache deduplicates non-fetch async work within one request; primitive arguments or stable object references enable cache hits.

nodes.label: Hoist Static I/O to Module Level
nodes.norm_label: hoist static i/o to module level

nodes.label: Avoid Shared Module State for Request Data
nodes.norm_label: avoid shared module state for request data

nodes.label: Module-level static I/O caching
nodes.rationale: Static assets and configuration are loaded once per module so repeated requests avoid redundant file or network I/O.

nodes.label: Request-scoped server render state
nodes.rationale: Concurrent server renders share process memory, so mutable request data kept at module scope can cause race conditions and cross-request leakage.

nodes.label: React useEffectEvent: Effect Event in Deps
nodes.norm_label: react useeffectevent: effect event in deps

nodes.label: Do Not Put Effect Events in Dependency Arrays
nodes.norm_label: do not put effect events in dependency arrays
nodes.rationale: Effect Event identity changes on every render; excluding it from dependencies avoids repeated effect runs and React Hooks lint errors.

nodes.label: Store Event Handlers in Refs
nodes.rationale: A ref or Effect Event keeps subscriptions stable when callback values change.

nodes.label: useEffectEvent for Stable Callback Refs
nodes.rationale: Reading current callback values through an Effect Event avoids stale closures and unnecessary effect reruns.

nodes.label: Prevent Waterfall Chains in API Routes
nodes.norm_label: prevent waterfall chains in api routes
nodes.rationale: Starting independent work immediately allows API route operations to overlap instead of waiting through sequential network latency.

nodes.label: Dependency-Based Parallelization
nodes.rationale: Starting each task as soon as its dependencies are ready maximizes parallelism.

nodes.label: Promise.all() for Independent Operations
nodes.rationale: Concurrent execution avoids serial round trips when async operations have no dependencies.

nodes.label: Use defer or async on Script Tags
nodes.norm_label: use defer or async on script tags
nodes.rationale: Without defer or async, scripts block HTML parsing; defer suits ordered DOM-dependent scripts and async suits independent scripts, reducing render blocking.

nodes.label: Use after() for Non-Blocking Operations
nodes.rationale: Schedule logging and follow-up work after sending a response so nonessential work does not delay it.

nodes.label: Use Lazy State Initialization
nodes.rationale: A lazy initializer makes costly initial state work run only on the initial render.

nodes.label: Extract to Memoized Components
nodes.rationale: Place expensive work in a memoized child after the parent's early return so loading states can skip the computation.

nodes.label: Extract Default Non-primitive Parameter Value from Memoized Component to Constant
nodes.norm_label: extract default non-primitive parameter value from memoized component to constant
nodes.rationale: A stable constant prevents fresh object, array, or function defaults from breaking shallow memo equality.

nodes.label: Do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in useMemo
nodes.norm_label: do not wrap a simple expression with a primitive result type in usememo
nodes.rationale: For cheap primitive expressions, dependency checking and hook overhead can exceed computation cost.

nodes.label: Avoid Duplicate Serialization in RSC Props
nodes.norm_label: avoid duplicate serialization in rsc props

nodes.label: Reference-based RSC serialization deduplication
nodes.rationale: Reusing the same object reference lets React Server Components serialize it once; client-side transformations avoid sending duplicate derived arrays.

nodes.label: Minimal Server/Client boundary payload
nodes.rationale: Passing only fields used by a client component reduces serialized response size and load time.

nodes.label: Wait for network idle before inspecting dynamic applications
nodes.norm_label: wait for network idle before inspecting dynamic applications
nodes.rationale: Waiting for JavaScript execution before DOM inspection avoids acting on incomplete dynamic content.

nodes.label: Reconnaissance-then-action browser workflow
nodes.rationale: Inspect the rendered application before acting so selectors come from its actual state.

nodes.label: Initialize App Once, Not Per Mount
nodes.norm_label: initialize app once, not per mount
nodes.rationale: Components can remount and rerun effects, duplicating app-wide initialization.

nodes.label: Check Cheap Conditions Before Async Flags
nodes.norm_label: check cheap conditions before async flags
nodes.rationale: Checking a cheap synchronous guard first skips unnecessary async work when the branch cannot succeed.

nodes.label: Defer Await Until Needed
nodes.rationale: Awaiting only on code paths that use the result avoids blocking paths that do not need it.

nodes.label: How We Optimized Package Imports in Next.js
nodes.norm_label: how we optimized package imports in next.js

nodes.label: Avoid Barrel File Imports
nodes.rationale: Barrel imports can load and analyze many unused modules, slowing development, builds, and cold starts.

nodes.label: Deduplicate Global Event Listeners
nodes.rationale: Sharing one global listener across hook instances avoids registering a separate listener for each component.

nodes.label: Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling Performance
nodes.norm_label: use passive event listeners for scrolling performance
nodes.rationale: Passive touch and wheel listeners let browsers scroll without waiting to check for preventDefault().

nodes.label: Use SWR for Automatic Deduplication
nodes.rationale: SWR shares requests, cache entries, and revalidation across component instances.

nodes.label: Hoist RegExp Creation
nodes.rationale: Hoisting or memoizing regular expressions avoids recreating them on each render; global regexes require care because lastIndex is mutable.

nodes.label: Hoist Static JSX Elements
nodes.rationale: Hoisting static JSX avoids recreating elements during renders, especially useful for large static SVG nodes.

nodes.label: Vercel Article on Package Import Optimization
nodes.norm_label: vercel article on package import optimization

nodes.label: Defer Non-Critical Work with requestIdleCallback
nodes.rationale: Scheduling non-urgent work during browser idle periods keeps the main thread responsive; timeouts or chunking support required or large tasks.

nodes.label: Use React DOM Resource Hints
nodes.rationale: React DOM hints start DNS resolution, connections, and resource or module loading earlier to reduce load time for critical and likely-needed assets.

nodes.label: Use Activity Component for Show/Hide
nodes.rationale: Activity preserves DOM and state for expensive components that frequently toggle visibility, avoiding costly rerenders and state loss.

nodes.label: CSS content-visibility for Long Lists
nodes.rationale: content-visibility auto defers layout and paint for off-screen list items, improving initial rendering.

nodes.label: Parallel Data Fetching with Component Composition
nodes.norm_label: parallel data fetching with component composition

nodes.label: Parallel fetching through component composition
nodes.rationale: Independent server components can start their fetches together instead of making a child wait for a parent fetch.

nodes.label: Per-item nested fetch chaining
nodes.rationale: Starting each dependent nested fetch as soon as its own parent result is ready prevents one slow item from blocking other items.

nodes.label: Frontend Design Skill
nodes.rationale: Ground visual choices in the subject matter to avoid generic default designs.

nodes.norm_label: plan de implementacion — diff de movimientos

nodes.label: Additive versioned audit snapshots
nodes.rationale: Keeping the existing IndexedDB store while extending events preserves historical records without reconstructing missing past values.

nodes.label: Preference Reset and Inventory Clear Separation
nodes.norm_label: preference reset and inventory clear separation

nodes.norm_label: base settings and local preferences tasks

nodes.norm_label: selected format precedence in printed documents

nodes.norm_label: locale-aware number, currency, date, and time formatting

nodes.label: Local Preference Repository Architecture
nodes.rationale: Field-by-field normalization preserves valid prior preferences while keeping preference storage independent from inventory persistence.

nodes.label: Cross-Tab Inventory Invalidation After Clear
nodes.rationale: Propagating a committed empty snapshot and invalidating stale drafts prevents old tabs or legacy demo copies from restoring cleared records.

nodes.label: Local Browser Preferences
nodes.rationale: Keeping preferences in localStorage separate from IndexedDB allows display settings to reset without changing inventory records.

nodes.label: Parallel Typed Translation Catalogs
nodes.rationale: Reusing the existing typed catalogs and preferences avoids introducing a second localization or persistence system.

nodes.label: Advanced Patterns
nodes.rationale: Groups advanced patterns for cases requiring careful implementation.

nodes.label: Bundle Size Optimization
nodes.rationale: Reducing the initial bundle improves Time to Interactive and Largest Contentful Paint.

nodes.label: Client-Side Data Fetching
nodes.rationale: Deduplication and efficient fetching patterns reduce redundant network requests.

nodes.label: Eliminating Waterfalls
nodes.rationale: Removing sequential waits avoids compounded network latency and yields large performance gains.

nodes.label: JavaScript Performance
nodes.rationale: Micro-optimizations in hot paths can add up to meaningful improvements.

nodes.label: Re-render Optimization
nodes.rationale: Reducing unnecessary re-renders minimizes wasted computation and improves responsiveness.

nodes.label: Rendering Performance
nodes.rationale: Rendering optimizations reduce the browser's work.

nodes.label: Server-Side Performance
nodes.rationale: Optimizing server rendering and data fetching reduces server-side waterfalls and response times.

nodes.label: Strategic Suspense Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Suspense lets wrapper UI render while data-dependent content waits, improving initial paint.

nodes.label: Version and Minimize localStorage Data
nodes.rationale: Versioning prevents schema conflicts; storing minimal fields reduces storage and limits accidental retention of sensitive data.

nodes.label: Avoid Layout Thrashing
nodes.rationale: Batch style writes and layout reads because interleaving them forces synchronous browser reflows; CSS classes improve separation and maintainability.

nodes.label: Animate SVG Wrapper Instead of SVG Element
nodes.norm_label: animate svg wrapper instead of svg element
nodes.rationale: Animating a wrapper enables smoother GPU-accelerated transforms where browsers do not accelerate SVG element animations.

nodes.label: Use Explicit Conditional Rendering
nodes.rationale: Explicit ternaries prevent 0, NaN, and other falsy values from rendering accidentally in JSX.

nodes.label: Optimize SVG Precision
nodes.rationale: Reduce SVG coordinate precision when the viewBox permits to lower file size.

nodes.label: Don't Define Components Inside Components
nodes.rationale: Nested definitions create new component types on each parent render, triggering remounts and losing state.
